final: WITH color_avgs AS (SELECT p.product_color, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost) AS color_avg FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), overall AS (SELECT AVG(color_avg) AS overall_avg FROM color_avgs), kept AS (SELECT c.product_color, c.color_avg, c.color_avg - o.overall_avg AS excess FROM color_avgs AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE c.color_avg > o.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(color_avg) AS kept_average FROM kept) SELECT k.product_color, k.color_avg, k.excess, k.color_avg - a.kept_average AS difference_from_kept_average FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_avg AS a WHERE k.color_avg > a.kept_average
